fusions.name: Silverside Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 spines from your skin in a spread, each one dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles. You dart 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Venom in the Fin
fusions.desc: A strike with a venomous spine deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scales Over Spines
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, your armour rises by 15% and your dodge chance by 10%.

fusions.name: Barbed Pilot
fusions.desc: A bonded needlenose swims at your side, darting at an enemy within 4 tiles every second. Each dart deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
